domains.name: Reading Comprehension (academic, professional, literary texts with nuance)
Integrated Written Expression (formal reports, argumentative texts, critical review)
Listening Comprehension (extended discourse, complex lectures, debates)
Oral Interaction and Expression (spontaneous, fluent expression on complex topics)

exam_rules: No electronic devices or dictionaries. Oral exams conducted with examiner present or recorded. SIELE is fully computer-based.
id_requirements: Valid government-issued photo ID (Passport, National ID card, or equivalent)

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-17: "La estructura del examen DELE C1 es la siguiente (la información que se ofrece a continuación expresa la secuencia de administración de las pruebas de examen):"

official_study_resources.title: DELE Modelos de Examen (Official Sample Papers)

prerequisites.description: None; recommended ~700+ hours of Spanish study

renewal_options: DELE certificates have lifetime validity. SIELE is valid for 5 years.

retake_policy.notes: DELE: no limit on retakes; CCSE: can retake immediately if failed
